profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer @ LeoRose Consulting | Front-End and Server-Side Development
profile.summary:
Senior Software Engineer with over 10 years of experience specializing in front-end and server-side development. Currently serving at LeoRose Consulting, contributed as the sole developer for the National Resource Directory (nrd.gov) and its in-house CMS. Partnered with a web designer and testing team to deliver client-requested enhancements, ensuring high-quality software delivery.  

Demonstrated expertise in web and server-side development, focusing on seamless client interactions and effective system upgrades. Dedicated to delivering impactful technology solutions through collaboration with cross-functional teams, supporting the success of mission-critical projects.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Washington, District of Columbia, United States · Remote
positions.description:
• Served as the sole developer for the National Resource Directory (nrd.gov) and its Content Management System, increasing site traffic to 10,000+ visits per week.  
• Partnered with web designers and testing team to implement client-requested enhancements.  
• Designed, developed, tested, and deployed high-quality sites utilizing Agile methodology.
• Implemented key Database Views, Indexes, and Queries, resulting in a reduction of page-load time by 50%.
• Maintained 100% client satisfaction and federal contractual requirements with regular deployments.
positions.insights: Skills: JavaScript · Front-End Development · Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) · Java · Spring MVC · RESTful WebServices · Web Development · Vue.js · Agile Methodologies · Software Design · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · JSON Web Token (JWT) · Spring Framework · HTML · Spring Boot

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Spearheaded a team of 4 in the resurrection and rebranding of the National Resource Directory (nrd.gov), launching the site six months ahead of schedule.
• Rewrote the entire code base in Vue.js, following the end-of-life of Angular JS. 
• Faced 75% staff reduction, streamlined development process, maintained 100% on-time delivery.
• Integrated RESTful Web Services such as Google Maps and USPS Address lookup to enhance user experience.
• Ensured system security and data integrity by implementing JWT authentication. 
• Collaborated on the Department of Defense Case Management System, used worldwide as part of the Warrior Care Project, resulting in a usage increase of 500%. 
• As part of the team, obtained a Secret Clearance, since expired.
positions.insights: Skills: SQL · JavaScript · Front-End Development · Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) · Java · Spring MVC · RESTful WebServices · Web Development · Vue.js · Agile Methodologies · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · JSON Web Token (JWT) · Spring Framework · HTML · Spring Boot

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.locationName: Winston-Salem, North Carolina, United States · On-site
positions.description:
• Worked as the sole engineer responsible for maintaining and upgrading Computer Assisted Dispatch (CAD) System.
• Collaborated with external vendors to create interfaces, ensuring seamless integration with their systems. 
• Assisted with the transition from Client/Server based COBOL CAD to Cloud-based Java CAD.
• Provided on-site support to clients, addressing and resolving reported issues effectively.
• Worked with several others in an Agile Software Development structure.
• As part of a federal-level contract, received security clearance from the FBI.
